Auto svg conversion with accessible names enabled

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.ConvertWithAccessibleNames("<p><svg aria-label=\"Name\"><text>Drawn</text></svg></p>", true, new ConversionOptions { InlineDataMedia = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<InlineDataMedia>("\"AltTextOnly\"", ConfigOptions)!, TierStrategy = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<TierStrategy>("\"Auto\"", ConfigOptions)! });
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
